name: – After recital F – Am 14
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: Fa. whereas UN human rights experts, in statements issued on 7 February, 7 May and 2 June 2026, called on the United States to end the economic, commercial and financial embargo against Cuba and to cease unilateral coercive and extraterritorial measures, including the designation of Cuba as a state sponsor of terrorism and measures contributing to what they described as ‘energy starvation’; whereas they warned that such measures, as well as threats and other forms of coercion and judicial weaponisation with extraterritorial effects, aggravate the humanitarian crisis, undermine the human rights of the Cuban people and are incompatible with international law;
